knowledge:
- key_parameters: URL=REST server URL for mapping features to CRMs ;; positive.bed=BED file of positive training genomic regions ;; negative.bed=BED file of negative training genomic regions ;; pssm=transfac file containing Position-Specific Scoring Matrices ;; background.freqs=background frequencies file for PSSM scanning ;; genome=genome assembly string (e.g., "dm3") ;; ngs=vector of NGS signal/peak files ;; data=feature matrix data frame with regions as rows, features as columns, and a binary response vector column (1 and -1) ;; ranges=list of parameter vectors to tune (e.g., cost and gamma) ;; kernel=SVM kernel type ("linear" or "radial") ;; feature.ranking=data frame of ranked features from rankFeatures ;; feature.nb=number of features to use in the model ;; cl=number of clusters/cores for parallel computation in LedPred
- alternatives: The package internally utilizes RSAT matrix-scan for TFBS scanning, BedTools for genomic overlaps, and IntervalStats for ChIP-seq dataset similarity via a REST server, which can be run manually if the REST server is unavailable.
- when_to_use: Use this workflow when you have a set of validated regulatory regions (positive set) and background/random regions (negative set) and want to train an SVM model using transcription factor binding sites and NGS data to predict and score novel regulatory elements across the genome.
- pitfalls: SVM models are highly susceptible to overfitting; always perform parameter tuning (C and gamma) and feature selection (Kappa coefficient optimization) using cross-validation. The mapFeaturesToCRMs function relies on an external REST server, which must be online and accessible. Feature scaling is performed internally by dividing by the Euclidean length of the feature vector to handle different data ranges (e.g., PSSM scores vs binary peak overlaps).

workflows.name: step_by_step_svm_prediction
workflows.intent: Build an SVM model from genomic regions and features step-by-step, tune parameters, select features, evaluate performance, and score unknown sequences.
input: positive.bed (BED file of positive genomic regions)
negative.bed (BED file of negative genomic regions)
prediction_small.bed (BED file of unknown sequences to score)
workflows.stages: 1. Map features to positive and negative CRMs to build the training set matrix ;; 2. Tune SVM cost and gamma parameters using cross-validation ;; 3. Rank features using Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) ;; 4. Determine the optimal number of features using Cohen's kappa coefficient ;; 5. Create the final SVM model ;; 6. Evaluate model performance with ROC and Precision-Recall curves ;; 7. Map features to unknown sequences without negative regions ;; 8. Score the unknown sequences using the trained model
workflows.code:
library(LedPred)
data(crm.features)
dirPath <- system.file("extdata", package="LedPred")
file.list <-   list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)
background.freq <- file.list[grep("freq", file.list)]
positive.regions <-  file.list[grep("positive", file.list)]
negative.regions <-  file.list[grep("negative", file.list)]
TF.matrices <-  file.list[grep("tf", file.list)]
ngs.path <- system.file("extdata/ngs", package="LedPred")
ngs.files=list.files(ngs.path, full.names=TRUE)
crm.feature.list <- mapFeaturesToCRMs(URL = 'http://ifbprod.aitorgonzalezlab.org/map_features_to_crms.php', positive.bed=positive.regions, negative.bed=negative.regions, background.freqs=background.freq, pssm=TF.matrices, genome="dm3", ngs=ngs.files,  crm.feature.file = "vignette_crm.features.tab",  stderr.log.file = "vignette_stderr.log", stdout.log.file = "vignette_stdout.log")
crm.features=crm.feature.list$crm.features
cost.vector <- c(1,3,10)
gamma.vector <- c(1,3,10)
c.g.obj <- mcTune(data = crm.features, ranges = list(cost=cost.vector, gamma=gamma.vector), kernel='linear', file.prefix = "vignette")
cost <- c.g.obj$e1071.tune.obj$best.parameters$cost
gamma <- c.g.obj$e1071.tune.obj$best.parameters$gamma
feature.ranking <- rankFeatures(data=crm.features, cost=cost, gamma=gamma, kernel='linear', file.prefix = "vignette")
feature.nb.tuner.obj <- tuneFeatureNb(data=crm.features, feature.ranking=feature.ranking, kernel='linear', cost=cost, gamma=gamma, file.prefix = "vignette")
feature.nb <- 60
model.obj <- createModel(data=crm.features, cost=cost, gamma=gamma, feature.ranking=feature.ranking, feature.nb=feature.nb, file.prefix="vignette")
feature.weights <- as.data.frame(t(t(model.obj$model$coefs) %*% model.obj$model$SV))
probs.labels.list <- evaluateModelPerformance(data=crm.features, feature.ranking=feature.ranking, feature.nb=feature.nb, cost=cost, gamma=gamma, file.prefix = "vignette")
positive.bed <-  file.list[grep("prediction_small", file.list)]
TF.matrices <-  file.list[grep("259_matrices_lightNames", file.list)]
prediction.crm.features.list <- mapFeaturesToCRMs(URL = 'http://ifbprod.aitorgonzalezlab.org/map_features_to_crms.php', positive.bed=positive.bed, pssm=TF.matrices, background.freqs=background.freq, genome='dm3', ngs=ngs.files, feature.ranking=feature.ranking, feature.nb=feature.nb, crm.feature.file = "vignette_pred.crm.features.tab", stderr.log.file = "vignette_pred.stderr.log", stdout.log.file = "vignette_pred.stdout.log")
prediction.crm.features <- prediction.crm.features.list$crm.features
pred.test <- scoreData(data=prediction.crm.features, model=model.obj, score.file="vignette_prediction.tab")

workflows.name: all_in_one_svm_prediction
workflows.intent: Build an SVM model and score unknown sequences using the all-in-one LedPred wrapper function.
input: positive.bed (BED file of positive genomic regions)
negative.bed (BED file of negative genomic regions)
prediction_small.bed (BED file of unknown sequences to score)
workflows.stages: 1. Map features to positive and negative CRMs to build the training set matrix ;; 2. Run the LedPred wrapper function to perform tuning, ranking, selection, and model creation in one step ;; 3. Map features to unknown sequences using the selected features ;; 4. Score the unknown sequences using the generated model
workflows.code:
library(LedPred)
data(crm.features)
cost.vector <- c(1,3,10)
gamma.vector <- c(1,3,10)
ledpred.obj=LedPred(data=crm.features, cl=1, ranges = list(cost=cost.vector, gamma=gamma.vector), kernel="linear", file.prefix="vignette2")
dirPath <- system.file("extdata", package="LedPred")
file.list <-   list.files(dirPath, full.names=TRUE)
background.freqs <- file.list[grep("freq", file.list)]
positive.bed <-  file.list[grep("prediction_small", file.list)]
TF.matrices <-  file.list[grep("259_matrices_lightNames", file.list)]
ngs.path <- system.file("extdata/ngs", package="LedPred")
ngs.files=list.files(ngs.path, full.names=TRUE)
prediction.crm.features.obj2 <- mapFeaturesToCRMs(URL = 'http://ifbprod.aitorgonzalezlab.org/map_features_to_crms.php', positive.bed=positive.bed, pssm=TF.matrices, background.freqs=background.freqs, genome='dm3', ngs=ngs.files, feature.ranking=ledpred.obj$feature.ranking, feature.nb=ledpred.obj$feature.nb, crm.feature.file = "vignette2_pred.crm.features.tab", stderr.log.file = "vignette2_pred.stderr.log", stdout.log.file = "vignette2_pred.stdout.log")
prediction.crm.features2 <- prediction.crm.features.obj2$crm.features
pred.test2 <- scoreData(data=prediction.crm.features2, model=ledpred.list$model.obj, score.file="vignette2_prediction.tab")
